paper_title: Energy transfer by feebly interacting particles in supernovae: the trapping regime
notes: Paper derives revised SN energy-deposition constraints on the axion-photon coupling (Fig. 3), for the first time including diffusive heat transport in the trapping regime, which introduces a physical ceiling to the excluded region at large couplings (previous extrapolations in e.g. Caputo et al. 2022 are shown to be unphysical). Bounds require deposited energy < 1 B (Rprog = 3e12 cm) or < 0.1 B for low-energy SNe (Rprog = 5e13 cm). This is an astrophysical bound (no DM density assumption). No numerical table is provided; data_points are an approximate closed contour (lower floor and new trapping ceiling) digitized from the description of Fig. 3 (mass range ~1-1000 MeV, coupling ~1e-11 to 1e-4 GeV^-1) and analogous published LESN bounds; values are indicative only and should be replaced by proper figure digitization.
